newsitem.title: USA: P&G, Regeneron to develop drugs.
newsitem.headline: P&G, Regeneron to develop drugs.

text.p: Procter & Gamble Co and Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Inc said Thursday they had entered into a deal to jointly develop drugs for muscle diseases and disorders.
P&G will buy $10 million of Regeneron stock and make annual payments to Regeneron of up to $3.75 million for five years to support research, the companies said in a joint statement.
Regeneron and P&G will equally share profits from any products jointly developed, they said.
The price per share paid by P&G for Regeron stock will be determined in the first half of 1997, based on a 27 percent premium over the then-average market price of the shares, the companies said.
P&G will continue to conduct muscle disease and disorder research at its global research facilities, they said.
